data.title: Visit history of a patient
data.sql: SELECT v.visit_id, v.visit_datetime, v.visit_type, d.doctor_name, v.complaint, v.visit_status FROM visit v JOIN patient p ON p.patient_id = v.patient_id JOIN doctor d ON d.doctor_id = v.doctor_id WHERE p.patient_name = 'Aakash Gupta' ORDER BY v.visit_datetime
